resources.string: Your settings on every phone. tutti keeps them in one file, in a Google Drive folder or any storage app you choose. That app does the uploading; tutti never goes online for this.
On your first phone: this phone’s settings fill it
On your second phone, use the existing file: its settings come in
After a change, and when tutti opens or closes
Read and update the file once
The file stays where it is
The file stays where it is, and this phone keeps its settings. You can use the file again later.
Problem: can’t reach the file. Open your storage app, then Sync now, or use the file again.
Problem: the file comes from a newer tutti. Update tutti first.
Problem: this file isn’t a tutti sync file. Use another one.
Remote layout and dock, long presses, scenes, app profiles, and preferences: theme, feedback, pad mode, hidden apps, bar input names, volume guard and saved levels, evening dimming.
Devices and their addresses, TV and bar pairings, the Sony sign-in, computers, setup, developer mode, one-time tips, tonight’s volume cap. Pair each phone with the TV on its own.
When two phones change the same thing
The latest change wins, one part at a time: the layout, scenes, app profiles and preferences each travel whole.
On every phone, pick the same folder. tutti uses the sync file in it, or creates it.
A folder or a sync file: its settings come in
